title: Vim Mode (Caps Lock Leader) - US layout

rules.description: Vim mode (Caps Lock leader) - hold Caps Lock for Vim-style navigation & editing; selection via visual mode [US layout]

manipulators.description: Caps Lock: hold = Vim leader / tap = nothing
esc: leave visual mode / cancel (also passes Esc through)
visual e / E: end of word
visual e / E: end of word
V: line-wise visual mode (selects the current line)
visual p: replace selection with clipboard
visual P: replace selection with clipboard
visual gg: select to start of document
gg: go to start of document
visual G: select to end of document
G: go to end of document
D: delete from cursor to end of line
Y: yank the whole line (same as yy)
J: join this line with the next
